text.p: Representatives of the German Volkswagen Group, visiting the south-western Polish province of Jelenia Gora, said they wanted to set up a motor-car factory there, the provincial spokesman said on Monday.

"The Germans are interested in manufacturing facilities in the Len SA factory in Kamienna Gora, a furniture factory in Lubawka or facilities in a former pre-fab housing factory in Jelenia Gora," PAP news agency quoted Janusz Rozlal as saying.
It was not immediately clear whether Volswagen was considering opening only a car-assembly plant using imported parts, a car-parts factory or a fully-fledged car factory.
Volkswagen now has a car-assembly plant in the western town of Poznan, which assembles Volkswagen delivery vans and passenger models of Skoda, a Czech carmaker partly owned by Volkswagen.
The Poznan plant, in which Volkswagen has a 25.4 percent stake in Poznan, has a production capacity of 20,000 units annually.
